definitions.nearestBodyReach: getMove range minus own bodySpread; standing target, no active/recovery hurtbox extension
definitions.nominalAdvantage: Post-contact action-ready arithmetic: stun - (active + recovery + 1), with parentheses. An isolated real-step check gives light attacker/defender first actions at16/11 ticks (-5), heavy30/18 (-12); ordinary cancels, pushback, flight/landing and knockdown are excluded. A conventional -1 counting convention would differ by two frames and is not the numeric convention in these columns. Projectile advantage is null.
definitions.projectileThreat: Damage*effective speed/(startup+recovery); null for beams, whose instantaneous reach is represented separately
definitions.projectileOverrides: Horizontal spit or raw.horizontal strips gravity/wave/bounces/ground exactly as step; standing default bolt aim
definitions.overshootMargin: Pure numeric diagnostic: primary front-body origin+one-tick shot motion minus closest standing-body far edge incl shot halfwidth; positive can skip a close target at release, not an observed outcome
definitions.limitations: Shared features are collinear across templates; coefficients are predictive associations, not independently identified causal prices. IDs are join keys, never proposed coefficients.
